Why choose Bordeaux

Bordeaux combines grand stone architecture along the Garonne with a strong wine culture.

Build a short break around Place de la Bourse and Cité du Vin. Use the official visitor guide below to check the exact locations and opening arrangements before grouping them into a day.

Shape the day

Place de la Bourse

Make this the anchor of your first day, with time for the surrounding streets and a meal. Check whether your chosen experience needs a timed ticket.

Cité du Vin

Save a separate block for this part of Bordeaux. Compare the route from your base before deciding whether to walk or take local transport.

Choose a base

For a first visit to Bordeaux, compare accommodation near your arrival point with options closer to Place de la Bourse. Check the actual walking route, luggage access and evening journey rather than relying on map distance alone.

Compare the full stay price and cancellation terms. A central address can reduce daily transfers, but check street noise and accessibility for the individual property.

A simple first plan

  • Arrival: settle in and take a short orientation walk.
  • First full day: allow time for Place de la Bourse and a nearby meal.
  • Next block: explore Cité du Vin, leaving room for weather or a slower start.

Festival programmes vary by season and year; check dates before planning around a particular event. Keep a weather alternative for outdoor sightseeing.
